omissionRisks.risk: Silently normalizing erroneous SRT text into the intended narration.
omissionRisks.why: The supplied raw cues contain consequential substitutions including CT/习题, 数标选题幾個/鼠标悬停即可, 提示此/提示词, 捕權/补全, 玩新天空/完形填空, 負增/附赠, 聽立/听力, and 深層/生成.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Run OCR on burned captions and key UI, preserve every raw cue verbatim, and create atomic conflict units with supported readings and remaining uncertainty.

omissionRisks.risk: Attributing the visible chat UI or every generated page to a fully identified DeepSeek product/version.
omissionRisks.why: DeepSeek text appears on output pages and the chat uses a recognizable whale-like logo, but URL, model/version, account, and workspace are not readable.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Capture visible brand text and chat chrome separately; record URL/model/version/account/workspace as unknown unless readable.

omissionRisks.risk: Inventing hidden upload, send, code-copy, save, export, or browser-open actions.
omissionRisks.why: The montage shows input, prompt/response, and already-open pages but not the full execution chain.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Build parallel observed-chronology and dependency ledgers; mark every unseen bridge unknown.

omissionRisks.risk: Misdescribing hover reveal as click-to-answer or assuming it works for every option/question.
omissionRisks.why: The pointer and row state change are brief and only one example is clearly visible.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Capture dense before/during/after frames around the pointer movement and identify exactly which row changes.

omissionRisks.risk: Treating the listening page as proof that TTS audio was generated and played.
omissionRisks.why: The narration asserts TTS while the page visually suggests listening; the source audio inspection does not isolate an audible TTS demonstration.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Inspect the control/UI and audio interval separately; distinguish claim, visual illustration, and missing playback evidence.

omissionRisks.risk: Treating the inserted cartoon as a demonstrated output of the DeepSeek workflow.
omissionRisks.why: The cartoon follows mnemonic output by edit, but no prompt, generation, export, or file handoff links them.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Capture the transition, watermark, and full cartoon interval; preserve source and causality as unknown.

omissionRisks.why: Only bounded portions of one four-option quiz, one cloze page, one answer-analysis page, one listening page, and one mnemonic response are visible.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Count conservatively by visible page/state and state that examples illustrate rather than establish universal capability.

omissionRisks.risk: Upgrading scene-detection cuts into semantic scene or edit counts.
omissionRisks.why: Most shots retain the same physical monitor/desk while camera angle, screen content, motion, and exposure change.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Compare boundary-adjacent frames and describe recurring environment plus unresolved hidden cuts without asserting edit count.

omissionRisks.risk: Losing the complete prompt, filenames, titles, qualifiers, and answer-state signatures because of small filmed-screen text.
omissionRisks.why: The video is portrait footage of a monitor with moiré and oblique angles; contact frames are insufficient for high-impact text.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Use targeted original-resolution frames and macOS Vision OCR, then visually accept or reject rows without silent completion.

omissionRisks.risk: Overclaiming decision-relevant absences from sparse samples.
omissionRisks.why: Access path, price, platform, account requirement, region, support/owner, and save/export controls could be brief or off-screen.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Inspect the full dense timeline and bounded opportunity windows; state only not observed in the inspected scope.

omissionRisks.risk: Ignoring the non-speech soundtrack or mistaking background audio for demonstrated UI/TTS output.
omissionRisks.why: The source has audio throughout and audio classification indicates music beneath narration.
omissionRisks.requiredFollowup: Record the separated-audio semantic classifier results and explicitly test the TTS interval for distinct playback evidence.
